SEARCH
Package patterns

Class ResearcherRegistry

java.lang.Object
patterns.ResearcherRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ResearcherRegistry extends Object implements Serializable
Singleton registry that keeps track of all ResearcherDecorators in the system. Maps user email to their ResearcherDecorator so any menu can check whether a logged-in user is also a researcher. Supports serialization so researcher profiles and papers persist between sessions.
